limitedSupersession.parentTransportStop: Superseded only to permit the additional P01 setup attempt and the attachment-coordination procedure specified here.
limitedSupersession.newModelRequests: Only the six previously authorized, still-unsubmitted probes.

runtimeAdmission.sourceBinding: Capture this response's actual message ID and exact-body SHA-256 and bind the new admission request to those values and this directiveId.
runtimeAdmission.failureAction: Stop controlled browser actions if admission is unavailable, malformed, denied, expired, or not bound to this directive.

permittedChanges: Attachment-event coordination within the existing supported browser client.
Narrow rendered-control selectors that exclude script and application-data elements.
Setup-attempt accounting and associated deterministic tests.
Source-bound directive and redacted operational checkpoint records.
repositoryBoundary.ifExistingImplementationAlreadyConforms: Reuse it without an unnecessary code change.
repositoryBoundary.privateArtifactHandling: Keep runtime markers, exact outputs, browser identifiers, and detailed receipts in the existing private artifact root with existing restrictive permissions.

technicalBasis.establishedPattern: Playwright documents starting the file-chooser waiter before the activating click, then awaiting the resulting chooser and assigning the file. ([Playwright][1])
technicalBasis.applicationBoundary: This documents the coordination pattern, not the capabilities of the installed restricted browser client. Use only methods and argument forms explicitly supported by that client's current tool contract.

required: The frozen fixture manifest, both fixture files, and all rendered prompts match their recorded identities.
Existing metadata still establishes zero submitted probes and zero assigned synthetic files. Stop on contradictory or ambiguous evidence.
The same authorized Brave profile and account remain active.
Latest and Pro, 5 of 5. are observed without inferring a backend model identity.
The required Temporary and Unpersonalized controls remain available without a global settings change.
The browser client responds to a bounded read-only check on the task-owned surface.
There is no unresolved dialog, upload, pending chooser operation, or unrelated draft that would make the next action ambiguous.
preAttemptReadiness.taskTabRule: Reuse an appropriate task-owned tab. If the existing tab contains the Project Manager draft, leave it undisturbed and create at most one dedicated probe tab in the same authorized profile and account.
preAttemptReadiness.staleDialogRule: Cancel an empty stale picker only when existing supported controls positively associate it with this task's failed setup. Do not close unrelated pickers, enter a path into an unidentified dialog, or use global keystrokes.
preAttemptReadiness.permissionRule: Read-only verification of existing permissions is permitted. Changing permissions, reinstalling extensions, or broadening access is not authorized.
preAttemptReadiness.clientContractUnavailable: Stop before opening another picker; do not guess an API method or argument.

procedure: Prepare the correct fresh chat, exact frozen prompt, and intended fixture path before starting any chooser wait.
Locate the actual upload trigger using a unique, visible, enabled interactive element. Complete any necessary attachment-menu navigation before arming the chooser waiter.
Use the installed client's supported coordination pattern to start the chooser wait before the activating click. Do not await chooser completion before issuing that click.
Keep waiter creation and the activating click in one coordinated browser-client execution, without intervening inspection, reasoning, or unrelated tool operations.
Await the chooser associated with that trigger and task tab. Assign exactly the intended frozen fixture once through the existing permitted file-selection operation.
Confirm the intended attachment is ready in the composer before submitting the exact frozen prompt.
attachmentCoordination.timeoutPolicy: Use the installed client's documented bounded timeout behavior. Do not invent timeout parameters, disable timeouts, or implement a repeated-click loop. Preserve the configured timeout in the receipt.
attachmentCoordination.onTimeoutOrCanceledChooser: Do not click again or assign a file through a late, unbound chooser. Preserve the failure, settle the pending operation using supported controls where possible, and stop.
attachmentCoordination.fileAssignmentAmbiguity: Record assignment state as unknown and stop. Do not repeat setFiles or treat an uncertain upload as absent.
unsupportedAlternatives: Injected file inputs or synthetic DOM upload events.
Native operating-system automation outside the existing permitted browser controls.
Clipboard, drag-and-drop, encoded text, or another transfer route substituted for the frozen attachment transport.

selectorAndPrivacyHardening.allowedProjection: Only the bounded composer, its visible interactive upload controls, attachment status, message identifiers, and necessary mode labels.
selectorAndPrivacyHardening.priorIncidentalExposure: Preserve the existing deviation receipt. Do not repeat, expand, or publish the exposed metadata.
selectorAndPrivacyHardening.unexpectedContentExposure: Stop the offending projection, preserve an operational incident record without copying the exposed content, and do not broaden inspection.

attemptCeiling.anotherSetupFailure: Stop the synthetic sequence immediately and return the exact operational blocker.

continuationRule.ifP01SetupSucceeds: Submit P01 once, capture its first completed response, and continue P02 through P06 under the unchanged parent prompt, fixture, mode, and parser contracts.
continuationRule.unexpectedCompletedResponse: Retain it, apply only the frozen deterministic parser, and continue. Do not repair, replace, or retry based on content or marker matches.
continuationRule.submissionOrCaptureFailure: Stop. An attempted submission with unresolved persistence must not be repeated.
continuationRule.temporaryChatRule: Capture the required exact bytes and mode evidence while each Temporary Chat remains open. Do not save or convert it to an ordinary chat.
continuationRule.automaticToolUse: Record without making it a retry criterion.

operationalReturnHandling.stagedDraftHandling: Preserve any earlier operational draft privately. Clear or replace it only if its exact identity is established and metadata confirms it remains unsent; never overwrite an unrelated draft.
operationalReturnHandling.newReturn: Send one new operational recovery receipt after completion or a blocker, using the existing authorized internal routing mechanism.
operationalReturnHandling.returnSubmissionAmbiguity: Check existing destination message metadata without another send. If persistence remains unresolved, preserve the return and report the transport state through the existing control channel.

requiredBeforeP01Recovery: The prior setup failure and unsent-return evidence remain intact.
Fixture and prompt identities match the frozen manifest.
The upload coordinator conforms to the installed client contract.
Any changed helper passes synthetic tests for waiter-before-trigger ordering, one trigger, one assignment, timeout without retry, and no send before attachment readiness.
Selectors reject noninteractive and script-bearing matches.
Applicable repository verification passes for changed code.
runtimeAcceptance.liveSuccessRequires: Observed attachment readiness followed by a single persisted probe request and exact response capture.

required: This directive's source message ID and exact-body SHA-256.
Fresh runtime-admission request and response identities.
Actual execution HEAD and any narrow implementation diff and test receipt.
Frozen fixture-manifest identity and prompt-hash checks.
Preserved original failure identities and separately numbered recovery setup event.
Client-contract reference, actual operation ordering, timeout behavior, and exact errors.
Chooser, assignment, upload, submission, and capture counts tracked separately.
One parent-schema metadata record per completed probe and explicit status for every unexecuted probe.
Exact raw-input and raw-output hashes, observed mode labels, and unavailable-identifier reasons.
Operational return persistence evidence or exact delivery blocker.
Confirmation of unchanged source artifacts, account settings, and zero paid operations.
completionEvidence.returnFormat: One operational JSON object without raw response prose, marker values, unrelated account metadata, or substantive interpretation.

prohibitedActions: Regenerate fixtures, change markers, alter prompts, change probe order, or substitute a different model or mode.
Select a file or submit a request through an unidentified or unrelated dialog.
Change global settings, accounts, permissions, project membership, or installed extensions.
Retry a completed response or repeat an ambiguous upload or submission.
Inspect existing private document contents, previous substantive responses, or cited targets as the worker.
Resume other experiments, issue additional model requests, or infer source-access conclusions.
Create a new transport service, provider API integration, credential, or public export.
Ask the owner to relay files or operational packets.
stopConditions: Fresh admission or frozen input identity verification fails.
The authorized environment or required chat modes cannot be confirmed.
A blocking dialog cannot be safely associated with this task.
The installed browser client lacks the required supported coordination capability.
A chooser, assignment, upload, submission, capture, permission, or control operation fails or becomes ambiguous.
All six probe receipts and the operational return are complete.
